slides.title: The gap between support offered and support used
slides.body: Most people are offered some form of wellbeing support. Far fewer reach for it on an ordinary day. Everkind is built for the days in between — the days that never justify an appointment.

slides.title: An AI-powered wellbeing platform
bullets: Journaling, voice reflection, and personalised meditation in one private space
Shaped with input from clinicians who advise the company
Explicitly not therapy and not clinical care — complementary to existing benefits

slides.title: One quiet place
bullets: Journal — write an entry, get a reflection back
Voice — speak instead, on the days writing is too much
Meditation — generated from your own entry, in your words
slides.fine: Product renders appear on the Product page. [DRAFT — PENDING SIGN-OFF]

slides.title: Insights Without Identities
slides.body: Everything on the individual side is private. Organizations see anonymized, aggregate engagement across the group — never an individual, and never an entry. Aggregate reporting is available only where at least {{MIN_COHORT}} people are enrolled.

slides.title: A daily rhythm, not a program
bullets: A daily check-in
Written or spoken reflection
A meditation generated from the entry

slides.title: Direct to people, and through organizations
bullets: A direct-to-consumer app for daily reflection and rest
Organizations buying an always-available wellbeing layer for their workforce
